title: LOCKS: Page-Local Compact Key Summaries for Efficient Long-Context Decoding
selection_reason: LOCKS uses page-local spectral summaries to avoid full KV-cache reads during long-context decoding and integrates with vLLM, directly extending sparse attention, paged-cache and long-context serving lineages.
